brief_title: Rate my board slideshow that invites the comment section in

structure.beat: Static board on screen with the rate my board question over it
Text cards walk through three wins from the week
Last card asks for a score out of ten

cta: Rate it out of ten in the comments
topic_shown: A wins board layout, shown as still cards
why_it_worked: asking for a score gives every viewer a one word comment to leave, and the board is specific enough that people compare it to their own
adaptation: show this creator's own weekly plan as the board and ask viewers to rate it out of ten instead of a generic template
avoid: The rate my setup post with a stock photo board nobody actually uses
